Download to watch offline Easily save your favorites for internet–free viewing and always have something to watch. Available in 190+ countries From Lagos to London, Accra to Atlanta, and across the globe. Immerse yourself in the soul of the motherland. Frequently Asked Questions What is your streaming service? Kava is a subscription-based streaming service, and the home of premium Nollywood and African cinema, offering unlimited access to a large catalogue of movies, TV shows and original content, with ad-supported viewing available in select markets. Where can I watch? Watch on your TV, phone, tablet or computer. Stream in web and mobile browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and on the iOS and Android apps, with Apple TVoS, AndroidTV, Fire TV, Vidaa, Samsung and LG Smart TV. Kava is available in 190+ countries. How do I cancel? You can cancel your subscription anytime from your Manage Subscription settings on the Kava Website. There are no cancellation fees, and you keep watching until the end of your current billing period. What can I watch? Post-cinema releases, exclusive titles you won’t find anywhere else, and Kava Originals crafted by Africa’s boldest storytellers, with new titles added regularly. How does Kava’s billing work? Kava is a monthly recurring subscription at $5.99/mo
